methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari led browsers (mobile) in Canada at 55.1% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome ranked second at 38.4%, followed by Samsung Internet at 4.27%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Safari leads at 55.1% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/canada.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Safari (55.1%), Chrome (38.4%), Samsung Internet (4.27%) in October 2026.
